name: TwoBarReversalBreakoutEntry
longCondition: el_lt(close[2], open[2]) && el_gt(close[1], open[1]) && el_ge(close[1] - open[1], bodyFraction * (high[1] - low[1])) && el_gt(close[0], pairHigh)
shortCondition: el_gt(close[2], open[2]) && el_lt(close[1], open[1]) && el_ge(open[1] - close[1], bodyFraction * (high[1] - low[1])) && el_lt(close[0], pairLow)
